navigationEditor.open.label: Customize navigation
navigationEditor.title: Customize navigation
navigationEditor.description: Drag to reorder. Move features into a directory or to the top level, and hide items you use less often. Changes apply to everyone using this server after you save.
navigationEditor.addDirectory.label: New directory
navigationEditor.newDirectoryName.label: New directory
navigationEditor.directoryName.label: Directory name: {{name}}
navigationEditor.directoryName.error: Enter a directory name of 1–80 characters.
navigationEditor.location.label: Location of {{name}}
navigationEditor.hide.label: Hide {{name}}
navigationEditor.show.label: Show {{name}}
navigationEditor.moveUp.label: Move {{name}} up
navigationEditor.moveDown.label: Move {{name}} down
navigationEditor.removeDirectory.label: Remove directory {{name}}
navigationEditor.removeDirectory.descrip: Removing a directory moves its features to the top level. Feature names stay fixed, and hiding an item does not disable it.
navigationEditor.emptyDirectory.descript: Move features here with their location selector, or drop them on this directory.
navigationEditor.parentHidden.label: Directory hidden
navigationEditor.unavailable.label: Unavailable here
navigationEditor.unavailable.description: This feature is unavailable for the current connection. Its position is kept and it appears on devices that support it.
navigationEditor.unknownMenu.label: Unavailable feature
navigationEditor.restore.label: Restore defaults
navigationEditor.cancel.label: Cancel
navigationEditor.save.label: Save
navigationEditor.saveFailed.description: Could not save. Your changes are still here; try again.
navigationEditor.drag.label: Drag {{name}} to reorder
navigationEditor.drag.instructions: Press Space to pick up an item, use the arrow keys to move it, then press Space to drop it. Escape cancels. You can also use the up and down buttons or the location selector.
